api_url.description: The root url of the APIM REST API solution to be used, without the /api url suffix. Must be also assigned at AZUREIPAM_API_URL environment variable.

skip_cert_verification.description: Specifies it the certificate chain validation must be skipped calling the API endpoint. Default to false.

token.description: The bearer token to be used when authenticating to the API. Must be also assigned at AZUREIPAM_TOKEN environment variable.

reverse_search.description: New networks will be created as close to the end of the block as possible?. Defaults to `false`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

settled_by.description: Email or identification of user that settled the reservation.

settled_on.description: The date and time that the reservacion was settled.

size.description: Integer value to indicate the subnet mask bits, which defines the size of the vnet to reserve (example 24 for a /24 subnet). Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

smallest_cidr.description: New networks will be created using the smallest possible available block? (e.g. it will not break up large CIDR blocks when possible).Defaults to `false`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

space.description: Name of the existing space in the IPAM application. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

status.description: Status of the reservation, a 'wait' status indicates that is waiting for the related vnet creation

tags.description: Auto-generated tags for the reservation. Particular relevance the 'X-IPAM-RES-ID' tag, since it must be included in the vnet creation in order that the IPAM solution automatically considers the reservation as completed.
